text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's a wrap for today!
Ah, great work today, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The following day, at dusk. After training wrapped up, I stood waiting with a
somewhat restless heart, watching the other girls head back to the lodge.
choice_data_list: (Waiting right here should be fine... right?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... Apologies for keeping you waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Please, take this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking inside the paper bag Air Messiah handed me... I was astonished.
It was the exact same book I had yielded to her at the bookstore yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I searched for other stores that had it in stock and luckily found one nearby...
I simply could not bear merely accepting it from you empty-handed.
choice_data_list: You went out of your way to buy this for me...?
You went out of your way to pick this up for me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said it was nearby... but the heavy rain had continued relentlessly yesterday.
I doubted that kind of trouble could be dismissed by just 'not bearing to take it'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words slipped out from the bottom of my heart.
Air Messiah. She truly is, through and through—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Earnest, you say? ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is my sole redeeming quality—
In fact, one could say it is my *only* redeeming quality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gasped reflexively, immediately realizing what she meant.
...The scene from the other day's mock race flashed back in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had built everything up through diligent, steady effort, only to fall before overwhelming talent.
For her to say it was her 'only redeeming quality' meant that deep down, she must—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why. I am proud to be this version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah spoke with her usual composure.
...And precisely because of that, her words carried an overwhelming certainty.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am not extraordinary. Nor am I eccentric.
I am plain, straightforward, and serious to a fault.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, that is precisely why.
—Steadfastly, reliably, step by single step, I can press forward toward glory.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is the 'strength' I inherited.
That is the 'pride' bestowed upon me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: From my mother, whom I respect and adore more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother. ...With that alone—
My heart overflows with the power to surge forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To me, Mother is the Tiara Umamusume
whom I respect above all others.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Being your daughter is my...
pride, my blessing, and my salvation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will achieve victory.
Turning the earnestness and steadfastness inherited from my mother into my greatest weapons.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will run through the Twinkle Series,
and—I will seize victory in the Triple Tiara races.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To prove that my mother was never merely a runner who 'fell just short.'
To prove the sheer greatness of everything connected and passed down to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no words to offer.
All I could do was gaze into her dignified eyes, burning with an unshakeable will.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And all I could feel was—
choice_data_list: (A profound... sense of shame in myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff, huff*... Hnnghhhh!!
...—*pant, pant, pant*.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Just five more sets... of planks...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the rest of the summer training camp, whenever free practice came around,
I saw Air Messiah relentlessly pouring herself into core training. ...Time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...! *pant, pant, pant*.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...A five-minute break.
And then... fifteen more kilometers of morning running...!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, gather around everyone! As the final wrap-up for summer camp,
we'll be holding another mock race. The running groups will be identical to last time!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Learn from your previous mistakes and show the fruits of your training out there.
First group, head to your starting positions!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp, the concluding mock race.
Facing off once again, Air Messiah and Cesario—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the race's final stretch, turned it once more into a fierce head-to-head duel.

text_block_list.name: Messiah & Cesario
text_block_list.text: HAAAHHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
She didn't get shaken off...?! Amazing!
Messiah-san is still clinging right onto Cesario-san—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anchored by an impeccably trained core, her form was polished to perfection.
It channeled the flow of power through her entire body with consummate precision—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Giving her a rock-solid footing capable of overcoming even the fiercest of rivals.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... Not just yet...!
AAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haah...! *pant, pant*...
—It seems I have lost once more. Magnificently run.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... But still.
Last time, it was a whole length. This time—you closed it to a neck.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed I did.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Solidly, steadily, one step at a time.
From a neck to a head. From a head to a nose.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And one day, without fail, I will pull ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —I swear it upon this bloodline. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah offered a proud, serene smile.
The moment I saw that profile of hers—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My mind was made up.
choice_data_list: (I want to be the person who can support her!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A late-summer breeze swept past.
The dawn of destiny carried with it the fresh, verdant scent of youth.
